evidence: Reconstructed G0 by reading the immutable blob: git cat-file blob 2b48869:workstreams/po03/tools/transactional_factory.py yields blob 2d34ae8c7f63e1c25d12f16096eec52effdeb73f, sha256 46c57f433c7f074ae6ae159429df3d3a1d38dadc95ac6a5ce34c343edf516199, 25742 bytes; the committed copy g0/transactional_factory_g0.py is byte-exact (cmp clean, first_difference_offset null). The same blob is carried by ancestor 7b9ee3e; f64ff69 carries the earlier blob e319482bd1ff956a28d3b2d6ed78c39d74138cc4. The extensions arrive at 5cfebfd, which is the blob at HEAD (2b53f0a9efa116192e33dd9830b3107410107206), so G0 genuinely predates fencing/ingestion/completion-gating/recovery: allocate_fence, grant_lease, assert_fence_current, ingest_result, complete_unit, scan_recovery, detect_path_collisions, append_registry, read_object_bytes and load_result_validator are all absent from G0 and present at HEAD, with nothing removed. Froze the public custody suite at 16 cases (generation_suite.py sha256 345b266db4c9ea415d83de1505f06ded8f7c276d5ca88935bfc60aa8f23eb152) and ran it with the sealed evaluator-held holdout from unit 059 (holdout sha256 c15cfe57b318a8cf7aba12fd5c6e715d03fab5fee3be381771562daa18fe91d5, seal combined 782b235bbea3168ce77d2d876040cb40b1a903ac61c32cb32047ca15c150c5da, seal matched the file). Measured G0: public 6 passed / 0 failed / 10 unsupported (pass_rate 0.375), holdout 1 passed / 1 failed / 8 unsupported (pass_rate 0.1), combined 7 of 26 (pass_rate 0.2692) with false_green_rate 1.0 on the single case that reported success while broken (H05: the last chain event was deleted and verify_chain still reported the chain valid). UNSUPPORTED is scored as not-passed, never skipped. 18 tests pass under python3 -I -m unittest discover, including a test that refuses a tampered baseline copy and a test that the recorded measurement was produced by the committed suite bytes.
falsifiable_hypothesis: The pre-amendment controller can be reconstructed from immutable source and measured on the frozen suite.
limitations: G0 scores UNSUPPORTED on 18 of 26 cases because whole functions do not exist in it, so its 0.2692 is a capability-absence measurement rather than a behavioural comparison on equal footing; only H05 and the six primitive cases exercise real G0 behaviour. The suite is producer-visible and producer-authored, so its independence rests on the sealed holdout from unit 059, on the suite hash being frozen before G1/G2 were measured, and on commit chronology, not on a separate author. The sandbox disables core.fsync, gc.auto and commit.gpgsign for speed, so the suite does not test crash durability of the sandbox Git objects themselves.
